title: Russia and Ukraine Open US-Mediated Talks in Abu Dhabi as Grid Strikes Continue
dek: Delegations began two days of talks in the UAE on Tuesday, with Zelenskyy calling the first day “constructive,” while overnight strikes on power substations forced emergency outages across several regions.
author: Meridian Newsroom

image.alt: Skyline of Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

keyPoints: Russian and Ukrainian delegations began two days of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday.
Zelenskyy called the first day “constructive and quite substantive,” per Al Jazeera.
Ukrainska Pravda reported five substations hit overnight, with emergency outages in Kyiv, Kharkiv, Poltava and Sumy.
No agreement had been announced in the sources reviewed for this story.
body:
Russian and Ukrainian delegations began two days of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday, as Russian strikes continued to hit Ukraine’s power network.

## Talks open

Zelenskyy called the first day “constructive and quite substantive” after a briefing from Kyiv’s negotiators in the UAE. He said humanitarian issues and security guarantees had been discussed, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/10/russia-ukraine-and-us-to-meet-as-zelenskyy-claims-battlefield-successes) reported. Rustem Umerov, head of Ukraine’s Foreign Intelligence Service, leads Kyiv’s delegation. Jared Kushner, working with US envoy Steve Witkoff, said there were “some good ideas how to bridge” the differences, and the Russian delegation includes Kremlin aide Vladimir Medinsky, the outlet reported. The [Guardian’s live coverage](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/10/ukraine-russia-war-us-talks-abu-dhabi-europe-latest-news-updates) quoted US Secretary of State Marco Rubio describing the talks as “very productive.”

## Strikes continue

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/10/8062138/) reported that five major substations carrying electricity between regions came under Russian strikes overnight on November 9–10, in Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Vinnytsia and Kirovohrad oblasts. Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi said Russia attacked ten regions overnight and that two people were killed in Ladyzhyn. Emergency outages were in effect in Kyiv, Kharkiv, Poltava and Sumy regions on Tuesday morning, according to [UA.NEWS](https://ua.news/en/war-vs-rf/u-kiievi-ta-chotirokh-oblastiakh-zaprovadili-avariini-vidkliuchennia-svitla). Those casualty and outage figures are Ukrainian official reports and have not been independently verified.

## What is not yet known

The talks were scheduled to run for two days. None of the sources reviewed for this story reported an agreement.

## Background to the talks

Al Jazeera’s pre-talks explainer described this week’s meeting as the fourth round of peace talks in 2026, with security guarantees for Ukraine high on the agenda. The outlet noted that the talks follow security consultations held in January and February. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot told Euronews that Europeans would join the talks, while saying that “no one will speak in our name.” Barrot also confirmed that France would take part, though he did not identify its representative, [New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/russia-ukraine-resume-abu-dhabi-talks-major-hurdles-remain) reported.

The Kremlin delegation included Vladimir Medinsky, director of Russia’s GRU military intelligence agency Igor Kostyukov, and Alexander Zorin, a First Deputy Head of the General Staff’s Information Directorate, according to Al Jazeera’s photo caption. Zelenskyy said humanitarian issues and security guarantees were discussed on the first day, and the second day is scheduled for Wednesday.
